scope: Material claims in the supplied article versions and audited sources. Claim wording is an audit restatement, not necessarily a verbatim author quotation. Not every sentence is a separate claim. Target locators are lexical aids.

claims.claim: Every adjacent strict inversion swap decreases the global inversion count by exactly one.
claims.boundary: Finite ordered lists; adjacent strict inverted pair; duplicate keys permitted.
claims.check: Pair cancellation argument; 158,323 distinct-key and 6,015 duplicate-key transition checks.
claims.limitations: Enumeration is finite; the mathematical argument supplies the unrestricted identity. Does not identify physical energy.
claims.revision_condition: A counterexample within the stated order and adjacent-swap assumptions, or a defect in the cancellation proof.
claims.strongest_alternative: Use the narrower claim stated in the boundary; other mechanisms are not excluded by agreement alone.

claims.claim: The equality delta I=-1 applies to every Selection or mixed-system swap.

claims.limitations: Strict inverted endpoints still decrease I, sometimes by more than one; arbitrary non-inversion moves are a separate claim.
claims.revision_condition: Restrict the equality to adjacent strict inversion swaps, or supply different program semantics.
claims.strongest_alternative: Use the narrower claim stated in the boundary; other mechanisms are not excluded by agreement alone.
